failure: With the installed codec, an existing generated DIMSTYLE test failed to export R12. The source fixture omitted INSUNITS, but LibreCAD had added its default unitless value. The codec reported failure during HEADER emission; targeted preflight observation identified INSUNITS as not representable on the old target.
change: For DXF targets before R2000, the adapter omits only integer group-70 INSUNITS zero. Nonzero or differently encoded values still reach the codec and remain subject to its refusal. DWG and modern DXF paths are unchanged. An opt-in CMake target runs existing public-interface filter tests with the installed codec without enabling the bundled-internals test suite.
authority: Autodesk's HEADER reference describes INSUNITS group 70 value 0 as unitless: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2026/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-A85E8E67-27CD-4C59-BE61-4DC9FADBE74A.htm
